inventory.notes: One donkey with red glasses and pink bandana, no tack; four legs counted; one easel; one teal cable to one small pale server tower on the horizon. Tool: stubby teal crayon. Canvas: blue-violet night field, pale crescent moon, small pink circle; no ring or orbit. No text or logos. Inspected at 554px on a contact sheet and at 72px, not on quadrant crops.

contact.notes: Grounded hooves sit on the ground shadow; the raised hoof holds: stubby teal crayon; easel legs on the ground; cable meets the easel foot and the tower base.
